slides.eyebrow: LIFE LESSONS FOR A BETTER YOU
slides.body: Aaj ka difficult chapter tumhari poori identity nahi hota.
Ek setback ko permanent label bana dena khud ke saath unfair hai.
slides.note: A day is not a life.

slides.body: Kabhi route badalna bhi growth ka important part hota hai.
Kabhi fast, kabhi slow—important hai ki tum seekhte raho.
Past ko repeat analyse karne ke bajay aaj ka ek useful step lo.
Thoda time do. Apni story ko beech me judge mat karo.

caption:
Aaj ka chapter difficult ho sakta hai, lekin wahi tumhari poori story nahi hai.

Apne next right step par focus karo.
